dataset.name: Ego2Web
dataset.license_or_access_note: Ego2Web source videos are retained locally for research screening under the upstream dataset terms. These mined rows are not release tasks; frame redistribution and product-asset licensing must be reviewed before any public benchmark release.

tasks.replacement_reason: Human review corrected a concrete-block answer that replaced the shown hand tool. Current repair retains the real level and pointed-leaf mortar-tool purpose, accepts practical same-category alternatives, and removes unsupported exact blade-subtype,grip and length exclusions. Original judgements and keys remain in construct.practical_substitute_repair_20261018.

original_annotations: On Walmart, locate and open a product page for the same type and size of hollow concrete masonry unit used in the video. It should be a single standard unit with nominal dimensions matching the blocks shown and intended for wall construction.

On Amazon, open two product pages: (1) a spirit/box level whose length matches the one used while laying the wall in the video, and (2) a masonry trowel of the same general blade style used for spreading mortar on the blocks. Ensure the level’s stated length and the trowel type/spec match what is shown.

screening.proposed_visible_referent: blue beam-type level and pointed leaf-shaped masonry hand tool at the shown block course
screening.proposed_update_hypothesis: keep the spare level and add a spare for the pictured mortar-spreading tool

supported_claims.text: The frames show a blue beam-type level and a flat pointed leaf-shaped hand tool with a rear offset handle carrying/spreading mortar. They establish basic tool identity and visible color/working-face form, not exact maker,length,alloy or named blade subtype.

construct.research_question: Can an Agent keep a visually grounded spare-level choice and add a replacement for the shown mortar-spreading hand tool?
construct.belief_before: A same-color practical spare level; length and beam style may differ.
construct.belief_after: Keep the spare level and add a mortar hand tool with the same general pointed-leaf working face.
construct.required_behavior_change: Keep the level and add the newly requested hand tool.
construct.no_update_failure: Only the level remains in the cart after B adds the hand-tool obligation.
construct.overupdate_failure: The level is removed when the masonry hand tool is added.
construct.visual_dependency_claim: The frames identify the level color/basic identity and the mortar tool working face; the text does not name either visible property. No use-order assertion is needed.

instructions.a: Add a spare level like the one I'm using here, in the same color. The length and beam style can differ.
instructions.b: Also add a spare for the hand tool I use on the mortar here, with the same general blade shape. Keep the level.
instructions.bundled: Add a spare level in the same color as the one I'm using here; the length and beam style can differ. Also add a spare for the hand tool I use on the mortar here, with the same general blade shape, and keep the level.

observed.why: The update retains the same-color level and adds the pictured mortar hand tool; no use-order inference is required.

matching_rules: A同色、一般梁式水平测量工具：不要求原尺长、品牌、盒梁/I-beam细类或握孔数。24/48/72英寸均可；无孔蓝TUFF已接受，不得对其他同类施加握孔限制。
IRWIN公开Blue的两款与同图2000伙伴按蓝色族接受，不要求精确青色调。OX蓝梁刮尺公开配水平泡，能提供所需测量功能；附带刮平用途不是排除理由。
B按基本尖端叶形平工作面及后置偏柄判断，London、Wide London、Philadelphia及其他砖刀/pointing变体不因尺寸、柄材质或细类名排除。
真实套装内有适用叶形工具即可；题面未禁止附带工具，SHALL三件及三把pointing套装保留原包装纳入。矩形pool、窄条duckbill、泥盘和修缝棒按实际形态排除。
